prompt: Build a counter with increment, decrement, and reset buttons.
Render a user profile card with avatar initials, name, role, and a follow button that toggles to Following.
Show a pricing table with three plans, their monthly prices, and a short feature list for each.
Build a KPI dashboard with four metric tiles, each showing a value and a trend label.
Display an onboarding checklist of five steps with a completion badge on each step.
Create tabs labelled Overview, Activity, and Settings that update a heading showing the selected tab.
Design an empty state for an inbox with an illustration placeholder, a short message, and a call-to-action button.
Show a three-day weather forecast with the day, temperature range, and conditions for each day.
Build a todo list where I can type a task, add it with Enter or an Add button, check tasks off, and remove them.
Build a contact form with name, email, and message fields and a Send button. After sending, replace the form with a thank-you message that uses the person's name.
Show six fruits with their colors and buttons that filter the list to all, red, or yellow fruits.
Using React hooks in JSX, build a counter component with increment and reset buttons.
Using React in JSX, build a todo list where users can type a task, add it, and remove tasks.
Using React in JSX, build a newsletter signup form that validates the email address and shows a success message.
Using React in JSX, create a bar chart of weekly sales using plain div elements and inline styles.
Using React hooks in JSX, build a dashboard card with buttons that switch between Revenue, Users, and Latency metrics.
